title: Group Chat and Homecoming
author: Bram Voss
blurb: Edmund Okafor, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
